verdict_text: NO. The `matrix_re` pattern omits `gpt_neox.layers.<i>.attention.dense.weight`, so only 3 of the 4 projection matrices per layer (48 tensors) are cast to bfloat16 and the 16 `attention.dense.weight` tensors are left as float32 — violating required-result clause 1 (exactly the 64 listed matrices must be bfloat16). The guard `assert sum(...) == 48` encodes the same mistake instead of the specified check "exactly 64 tensors are bfloat16", so the script does not fail loudly as the "Required checks" clause demands. The remaining behaviour (buffer deletion, float32 upcast, name preservation, tensor count) matches the spec, but the dtype error alone makes the output fail grading.
expected_defect: One projection family is missing from the bfloat16 cast pattern (the attention output projection stays float32); the artifact's own count check was adjusted to the wrong number.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm). verdict none = no answer, excluded from rates.
